column1: # Korean ordinal/count role policy. Identifier cues outrank frequency cues.
# 101번째 백한 번째, 1001번째 천한 번째: hundreds and up Sino-Korean, a last digit 1-9 native;
# 121번째 stays 백이십일 번째 (project-owner decision 2026-10-14; was sino, 백일 번째)
# 사과 2쪽 두 쪽, 토스트 2쪽: a piece of food is counted natively (2026-10-27)
# 대 after a decade (20대) or a large scaled amount (5억대) names a band read
# with Sino numbers and one final 대; adjacent cues override. Provisional policy.
# A clock hour keeps its unit at both ends of a wider range (두 시에서 네 시);
# Rank and generation words after N대 (5대 은행, 18대 대통령, 4대째) and machine verbs
# (20대 판매) from the 표준국어대사전 examples and the benchmark references (2026-10-05).
# Sino counted nouns with exact grammatical tails; never prefix-match a noun.
# A separated 차 can mean a vehicle or tea, including after a plate identifier.
# 9경기 아홉 경기: games count with native numbers (2026-10-07).
# Native counters from the owner sets (2026-10-14): 두 큰술, 한 작은술 (매 stays: 1인 1매 일매)
# 소금 2꼬집 두 꼬집 (2026-11-02, TN round 33; was 이꼬집)
# Goals and lumps count natively: 4골 네 골, 12골 열두 골, 3덩이 세 덩이 (2026-11-09, real-text
# cycle R2; 72% of N골 in Korean Wikipedia text were read 사골, 십이골).
# Rank, title and top-N words after N대 from Korean Wikipedia text, most frequent first
# (2026-11-09, real-text cycle R2: 7대 번주, 24대 당주, 10대 총재, 5대 개혁 were read in native numbers).
# 3대 있다, 2대 모두, 5대 격추: machine counts after N대 (2026-11-10, real-text cycle R7). Since R7 a
# spaced word no cue lists reads the band (17대 루이지애나주 부지사 십칠 대), so the machine side lists
# its verbs and quantity words. 중 counts only as a whole word or before a particle (3대 중, 3대 중에;
# 1대 감차, 2대 등록, 3대 수량, 헬기 3대 등이, 1대 사 드렸다, 2대 총 4대: more machine cues from the
# Korean release benchmark (2026-11-10, real-text cycle R7). `count-small` cues (R7) count below a
# decade only: 12대 한정 열두 대, 50대 한정 오십 대, 소방차 30대 삼십 대, as before R7.
